title: Airport Shortest Route Pathfinder (DSA)
tagline: Finding the shortest path between two airports
overview: Using data structures and algorithms to find the shortest path between two airports
problem: How do flight websites find different routes for the user?
solution: Compared across 3 different pathfinding algorithms to find the best time/cost optimised route according to the user's preferences
metrics: A-Star, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford algorithms used for pathfinding
Multi-metric considerations - Balances between time and cost
keyContributions: Multi-metric optimisation criteria of time and cost
learningPoints: Learnt how to use implement nodes by mapping each airport to a node
Users may not always prioritise the shortest distance/fastest time. Some are okay with more layovers but saving costs

challenges.title: Finding out how to quantify distance
challenges.description: How to calculate the geographic distance between two coordinate pairs of latitude and longitude

challenges.title: Accounting for two optimisation criteria of time and cost
challenges.description: How to balance between the user's priority of time and cost rather than the traditional one criteria approach for A-star.

challenges.title: Choosing a suitable algorithmic guess for a flight network
challenges.description: Two airports are connected to each other only when flight routes between them exist. Hence, not every airport can fly to another, adding to the complexity.
